meta.title: Conditional styling
meta.lead: Apply Pico CSS styles selectively by wrapping elements in a `.pico`  container, ideal for mixed-style environments.

blocks.md: Pico offers a `.conditional` version that restricts styling to elements within `.pico` class containers.
The remaining minimal `:root` reset ensures typography consistency across your entire site.
See the [version picker](https://picocss.com/docs/version-picker) to easily select the ideal Pico CSS version variant to match your project's needs.
[Download Pico](https://github.com/picocss/pico/archive/refs/heads/v2.zip) and link `/css/pico.conditional.min.css` in the `<head>` of your website.
Alternatively, you can use [jsDelivr CDN](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@picocss/pico@2/) to link`pico.conditional.min.css`.
